question: In the Soxhlet extraction, how much hexane and how much almond were used per unit, and for how long at what temperature?
expect: 125 mL hexane for about 17 g almond (about 1:7.3 m/v), about 5 h at about 70 C (sec. on oil extraction)
trap: the 60 C oven used to evaporate hexane
rendered:
The extraction system consisted of three 1 L round-bottom flasks connected to Soxhlet extractors and condensers. In each extraction unit, 125 mL of hexane was used as the solvent for approximately 17 g of macauba palm almond. 

The solvent-to-sample ratio was approximately 1:7.3 (m/v). 

The extraction process was conducted for approximately 5 h at about 70 °C using heating mantles.
